Only Close looks changed, and I can't say when. I found nothing dated after Monday that changes the other four prices. I ran out of search budget, so the news searches were shallow.

- **Close:** changed. My earlier answer said Startup at $9. The live page now lists Solo, Essentials, Growth and Scale. Solo is $9 per user per month but limited to 1 user [R5]. For 20 people the entry plan is Essentials at $35 (struck-through $49) [R5]. The page doesn't say which billing cycle the $9 and $35 apply to, and I can't tell when the plans changed.
- **HubSpot Sales Hub Starter:** unchanged as checked. List price is $20 per seat per month, and the page shows a $7 promo for new customers [R1]. I can't tell whether that promo existed on Monday.
- **Pipedrive:** unchanged as checked, apart from the name. The $14 per seat per month, billed annually, plan is now called "Lite" rather than "Essential" [R2]. A Pipedrive "MCP Skills" page is dated Nov 10 [R12]. I couldn't confirm it is a new launch.
- **Zoho CRM Standard:** unchanged as checked. The page shows US$14 per user per month [R3]. It has a monthly/annual toggle, so I can't confirm which period that figure uses.
- **Salesforce Pro Suite:** unchanged as checked. $100 per user per month, billed annually [R4]. Salesforce announced a Quick Pages beta on Nov 5, which is before Monday [R17].

Checked: I read the live pricing pages for HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Salesforce and Close. I also ran one news search per vendor with a Nov 9 start date. I found no change for HubSpot, Zoho or Salesforce in what I checked.
